subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: What canonical public Gateway activity and Control UI progress contract should OpenClaw expose for per-session busy, waiting, latest-action, stale/delayed delivery, and child-session state?
rationale: The requested UI depends on public gateway/session semantics and overlaps multiple open implementation candidates; automation cannot safely choose the API shape, phase taxonomy, persistence/reconnect rules, or which PR should own it.

options.title: Approve canonical activity contract
options.body: Define the gateway-owned activity/attention schema and then land a small Control UI progress strip against that source of truth.

options.title: Narrow to UI-only progress
options.body: Ship a limited Control UI indicator from existing session/tool events while accepting that deeper waiting/reconnect semantics remain unresolved.

options.title: Defer until broader session API lands
options.body: Keep this issue open as the UI consumer of the broader session activity work and avoid partial UI heuristics for now.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical activity contract
recommendation.body: Define the gateway-owned activity/attention schema and then land a small Control UI progress strip against that source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the broader open activity-contract issue and has recent gateway/protocol-adjacent history; that decision should lead the UI slice.
